# Wildhaven Hearth
> Your own AI at home on your computer that looks after itself: it never drops the conversation, every pack installs and
> uninstalls cleanly, and the Brainstem engine runs exactly as published. By Wildhaven Homes.

Release: 1.0.1 (engine sha256 bd55a7f0bcf5, grail-layers 93068e6, RAR 688bf5d)
Install: curl -fsSL https://wildhaven-homes-llc.github.io/hearth/install.sh | bash
Guide for AIs (install, verify, add, remove): https://wildhaven-homes-llc.github.io/hearth/skill.md
API front door: https://wildhaven-homes-llc.github.io/hearth/api/v1/index.json
Any AI (GitHub Copilot Agent mode by default): https://kody-w.github.io/grail-layers/skills/rar-easy-mode/SKILL.md
Index (JSON): https://wildhaven-homes-llc.github.io/hearth/registry.json
Release pins: https://wildhaven-homes-llc.github.io/hearth/release.json
Rules for any AI: https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/RAPP.md
